files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: Join trips.csv to stations.csv on start_station = station_code and use the start station's district (trimmed and written with each word capitalised, e.g. Old Town). `result` should be a table indexed by district in alphabetical order with columns trips (count) and total_km (sum of distance_km, 2 decimals).
intended_computation: Read trips.csv and stations.csv (codes as text); attach the start station's district (strip spaces, each word capitalised, e.g. Old Town); per district: trips = number of trips, total_km = sum of distance_km (2 decimals). Index district, alphabetical.
